Foodwise Market Match Program

Market Match doubles CalFresh (EBT / SNAP) food dollars at participating farmers markets so families can bring home twice as much fresh, locally grown produce while directly supporting small California farms.

Foodwise Market Schedule Daily Match Cap
Alemany Farmers Market Saturday, 7:00 AM – 2:00 PM $10 per market
Ferry Plaza Farmers Market Tue & Thu 10am–2pm, Sat 8am–2pm $15 per market
Mission Community Market Thursday 3pm–7pm (Mar–Nov) $15 per market

Shoppers swipe their CalFresh EBT card at the Foodwise Info Booth and receive matching Market Match coins redeemable for fresh fruits and vegetables. Learn more at foodwise.org/programs/market-match.

About Alemany Farmers Market

Opened on August 12, 1943, the Alemany Farmers Market is California's oldest continuously operated farmers market. Known affectionately as "The People's Market," it hosts up to 90 small family farms and food businesses every Saturday, year-round, rain or shine.

Address 100 Alemany Boulevard, Bernal Heights, San Francisco, CA
Hours Saturdays, 7:00 AM – 2:00 PM (Year-round)
Operator Foodwise (nonprofit operator since February 2026)
Transit Muni lines 9, 23, 67 · Free on-site parking
